subject: Coordination: HQ workshop logistics & guest laptop policy
messages:
From: Kelly O'Neal <kelly.oneal@brightcare.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <s.gupta@brightcare.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onsite workshop — can BrightCare bring 2 laptops + demo server?

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for offering HQ space for our joint workshop. Two quick logistical items as we start booking travel:

1) Equipment — our engineers want to bring two company laptops and one small test server (rackable 1U) to connect to your local demo network. Any restrictions?
2) NDA — Samir says legal would prefer to sign a standard mutual NDA before hands-on demos. Can you share the draft or DocuSign link?

Tentative date: Thursday, September 9th. We’re flexible by a day if that helps with room availability.

Appreciate it — Kelly

Kelly O'Neal
Partnerships, BrightCare Health
kelly.oneal@brightcare.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: BrightCare_request_summary.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Kelly O'Neal <kelly.oneal@brightcare.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — can BrightCare bring 2 laptops + demo server?

Hi Kelly — welcome aboard, happy to host. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Equipment: Small lab gear and laptops are fine. For the 1U server, facilities will need the exact dimensions and power draw so we can pre-stage a rack slot and power strip. Please send a spec sheet.

- NDA: I’ve attached our standard mutual NDA for review and uploaded it to DocuSign for signature (link below). If BrightCare has edits, send them back and I’ll loop legal.

- Room & date: We have Room 3A (ground floor, panel room with projector + HDMI KVM) available on Sept 9 and Sept 10. I’ve copied Lauren and Logan to confirm AV and building access.

Next action items:
• Kelly — send server spec + list of attendee names and emails for badges.
• Lauren — can you confirm AV laptop count + whether we need an Ethernet drop for the demo server?
• Logan — confirm visitor badging process and whether we require escorted access for server movement.

Thanks,
Mateo
Engineering Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com | +1 (628) 555-0987

Attachments: BrightCare_NDA_draft.pdf (attachment stub)
Related link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/BRIGHT-6789-NDA

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Kelly O'Neal <kelly.oneal@brightcare.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — can BrightCare bring 2 laptops + demo server?

Mateo / Logan — looping in details from Facilities & AV ops: 

- AV: Room 3A supports 2 HDMI inputs simultaneously and one laptop via wireless presentation. We have an HDMI KVM switch if you want to toggle the server output. If you need an Ethernet drop, we can provision a temporary port; please confirm whether the server needs static IP or just DHCP.

- Power & rack: 1U server OK but Facilities requests the server arrive on a dolly; we’ll meet the delivery team at the loading dock. Max 500W draw. If they exceed that, we’ll need advance notice.

- Security / badges: Standard visitor badges for all guests. For moving hardware through secure areas, an escort is required. Logan, can you handle escort for the setup window (we recommend 08:00–09:00 on the day of)?

I’ve attached a quick AV checklist for Room 3A.

Thanks,
Lauren
Program Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: Room-3A_AV-checklist.pdf

From: Samir Gupta <s.gupta@brightcare.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Kelly O'Neal <kelly.oneal@brightcare.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — can BrightCare bring 2 laptops + demo server?

Thanks for the quick answers — two small clarifications from legal/ops: 

1) NDA redlines: Legal has a single request to limit the mutual confidentiality term to 24 months instead of 36. I attached a one-page redline. If that’s acceptable, we can sign via DocuSign today.
2) IP isolation: Our infra team prefers the demo server to be on an isolated VLAN with outbound blocked except to your demo host IPs. Is that possible?

If both are OK, we’ll finalize travel.

— Samir
Senior Engineer, BrightCare
s.gupta@brightcare.com

Attachments: BRIGHT_NDA_redline_24m.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <s.gupta@brightcare.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Kelly O'Neal <kelly.oneal@brightcare.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — can BrightCare bring 2 laptops + demo server?

Samir / team — confirmed items below, and happy to finalize: 

- NDA: Legal approved the 24-month confidentiality window. I’ll route the redline back to our legal and update the DocuSign envelope; you should receive the signing request within 30–60 minutes.
- Network: Dev — can you provision an isolated VLAN for BrightCare’s demo server on Sept 9 between 07:30–09:30 for setup and 09:30–12:30 for the workshop? Outbound will be limited to the demo host IP-range. Please confirm IPs and any port rules.
- Badging & escort: I’ll own the escort window 07:45–09:15 and meet the delivery driver at the loading dock. Attendee list and photo IDs by EOD Thursday please.

Booking: Room 3A is locked for Sept 9, 08:30–12:30. Please advise if you prefer Sept 10 instead.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Facilities & Real Estate Operations | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood-inference.com | +1 (628) 555-0114

Attachments: —
Related link: https://redwood-inference.app/rooms/3A-booking
